venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: At Emos, we strive to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to all. The main entrance to Emos is fully accessible. Please be advised that this is done on a first come, first serve basis and our accessible seating area can reach capacity early. All bathrooms within the venue are equipped with ADA accessible stalls. ADA parking is first come, first serve and is located in front of the venue main entrance near our security checkpoint. Anyone needing prescription medicine must present the pharmacy labeled container which states the prescription, dosage, and patient name to our medical staff at each entrance gate.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information on our venue policies and FAQ, please visit our website https://www.emosaustin.com/
generalInfo.childRule: All guests ages 3 and older need a ticket for entry. Please provide ear protection for children.

events.pleaseNote: SEATING Your Antones ticket grants you General Admission entry with standing room. Limited seating may be available on a first-come, first-served basis, but is subject to change show to show. If you have an ADA request, please reach out and we will do our best to accommodate you. PARKING We recommend booking convenient and affordable downtown parking in advance through SpotHero. For street parking, please check posted signs and pay stations for enforcement information. Valet parking is available for purchase at The Westin Hotel, across the street from Antone?s, at 310 E 5th Street. FOOD Antone's proudly serves beer-steamed Cliffy Dog hotdogs and Antone's Famous Po Boys in five classic varieties: Original, Turkey & Swiss, Premium Roast Beef, Tuna, and The Piggy. These iconic sandwiches, created by Clifford's uncle Jalal in 1962, are available with Zapp's New Orleans Kettle Style Potato Chips.

venues.name: Moody Amphitheater

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Moody Amphitheater Box Office will only be open on any day there is a ticketed event at Moody Amphitheater. On event days, the Box Office will open at 5pm or 1 hour prior to the event start time, whichever is earlier.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Moody Amphitheater is a cashless venue. Most major credit cards are accepted, including tap to pay.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: All ticket purchases made online or through the box office are delivered electronically. If you are to receive tickets from a member of the tour or a giveaway via will call, tickets may be picked up at the box office upon venue opening. In order to pick up tickets, guests must present a valid government photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: There are multiple parking options available for guests attending events at Moody Amphitheater. Paid parking is available at the Texas Facilities Parking Garages located between 12th St. and 17th St. along San Jacinto Blvd and Trinity St. Access garages from 15th street to avoid traffic in the south Red River Area.

generalInfo.generalRule: Moody Amphitheater requires clear bags for entry, permitting only clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags no larger than 12" x 6" x 12" or small clutch bags/purses (4.5" x 6.5" or smaller). No lawn chairs, metal water bottles, selfie sticks, or cameras with removable lenses are permitted. Please visit moodyamphitheater.com for more on venue policies or contact info@waterloogreenway.org to verify permitted items.
generalInfo.childRule: Park goers of all ages are welcome at all Moody Amphitheater, unless otherwise stated on the event page. Children two (2) years and under do not require a ticket, but they must sit on a parent's lap. Tickets are required for children ages three and up.
